verdict.rationale: Stripe's ACP-style custom integration documents explicit create/update/confirm checkout-session hooks with defined states (incomplete|ready_for_payment|requires_escalation|processing|completed|canceled), and the OCA/embedded flow explicitly covers 'cart management' as part of the checkout lifecycle — this is a documented protocol call for creating/updating an order draft. However, access is gated behind a waitlist and private preview, limited to the US (or US/Canada/select EU for ACS), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of a live cart-update call succeeding. missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of live cart create/update calls, GA (non-waitlist) availability, broader geographic coverage.
